## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `deadline-anytime-assembly`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-07-12T19:06:43.973Z.

Planning pass 2026-07-12 (directed maintainer pass): Algorithm (18) deadline-aware anytime assembly — latency-budgeted top-k fusion with early termination and disclosed completeness. Purpose: the catalog prices context in TOKENS ((4)/(9)) and bounds candidate COUNT ((7) quotas), but nothing yet makes assembly adaptive in TIME — "optimal context at any possible time" requires pm context/next to return the best answer computable within an explicit latency budget, at any workspace size, improving monotonically when given more time, never blocking an agent turn on a cold cache or a million-item index. Mechanism, three parts. Part 1 — impact-ordered sources with upper bounds: each funnel source ((7)) exposes its slate as a descending-impact iterator carrying a per-source score UPPER BOUND for its unseen remainder (activation slates are already sorted by the write-time fold (6); ANN indexes stream in distance order; graph expansion is BFS by damped depth (2), bound = damping^depth). Part 2 — threshold-algorithm fusion: consume sources round-robin under Fagin TA/NRA semantics — maintain the best-k fused scores ((5) RRF or (3) learned linear, both rank-monotone) and a threshold = fused score of a hypothetical item ranked next in EVERY source; STOP when best-k >= threshold (exact top-k certified without exhausting any source) OR the deadline fires (return best-so-far with the threshold gap disclosed in the envelope as a completeness certificate). Part 3 — degradation ladder under deadline pressure: per-stage budgets (recall/fuse/pack); on overrun, shed in fixed order — (i) shrink per-source quotas, (ii) skip read-time signal recomputation and serve folded state only ((6)/(8)), (iii) drop enrichment blocks (orientation (16), precedents (10)/(12)) before core ranking, (iv) emergency path = claims + open-loop floors (11) + top folded activation, always O(k) straight off the fold. Every shed step is disclosed ("degraded: semantic source skipped, 40ms budget") so agents and the pm-atfm harness can distinguish deadline-induced quality loss from ranking regression; --explain-ranking stays truthful (3). Composes: (7) quotas become ceilings, not targets; packing (4)/(9) is greedy so its anytime property is inherited free (any greedy prefix is a valid packing); the cursor/bounded-output contract (pm-dfg0, shipped PR#525) is the wire shape for "more time available = resume deeper". Spectrum behavior: small workspaces certify exact top-k in microseconds — the ladder never engages, zero behavior change; million-item decades-deep archives get a hard latency ceiling per envelope with graceful, DISCLOSED degradation instead of timeouts or unbounded scans. Distinct from (7) (bounds WHAT is considered; this bounds WHEN consideration stops, with a certificate), from (4)/(9) (token budget = output size; this is compute budget = answer latency), and from pm-irp1/pm-gt82 startup latency (process boot cost; this is per-query algorithmic termination). Ownership: deadline parameter + fusion loop land with the wave-3 packer (pm-55ra, unblocked since PR#525); impact-ordered iteration is a DESIGN CONSTRAINT on the pm-801d persistent read index layout (noted there) so the index does not lock this out.

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
